label: pjm 69 cc/ct rebalance
definition: pjm 69 — PJM keeper (supersedes pjm-67). LIVE DELTA vs pjm-67 is the CC/CT offer-curve rebalance: CC_REGULAR committed 0.95->1.00 (shift CC rightward), CT_PEAKER committed 1.10->1.05 (let CTs compete earlier), targeting the 2024 CC_REGULAR overshoot / CT_PEAKER undershoot. pjm-69 CC_REGULAR/CT_PEAKER: 2024 331.4/17.0 TWh, 2025 321.6/29.7 TWh. SEAM CAPS INERT: pjm_seam_flow_limit + pjm_seam_export_limit are enabled but DO NOT BIND — 2025 net export stayed +38.2 TWh vs actual +18.0 (target 18-22 unmet), interchange/prices ~unchanged from pjm-68. Root cause: the per-seam (month x hod) p90 export envelope, summed across the 5 neighbors, reconstitutes ~14.9 GW avg (~full 16.3 GW TTC) vs 2.1 GW actual net export, so frac~=1 and the export min_gen floor never binds (shared border zones AEP_Ohio / Dominion further inflate the sum). A per-seam marginal-p90 cap cannot bound PJM joint net position; the aggregate simultaneous-transfer-limit fix is deferred to pjm-70. All other settings pjm-68 verbatim.
